say:0:1111001001:0.text: Look! Are those the Quicksand Claws?
say:0:1111001001:0.source_cn: 看！前方那些人好像是流沙之爪！

say:1:1111001002:0.text: It didn't take long to find them at all.
say:1:1111001002:0.source_cn: 没想到这么快就碰上了。
say:1:1111001002:0.male: It didn't take long to find them at all.
say:1:1111001002:0.female: It didn't take long to find them at all.

say:0:1111002001:0.text: We've got to get these hostages back to the main camp.

say:3:1111002004:0.text: We'll take a sand bath once this is over!

say:0:1111003001:0.text: ...These men are so carefree while my people suffer.
say:0:1111003001:0.source_cn: ……我的同胞在受苦，这些人却这么逍遥自在。

say:2:1111003003:0.text: Well, we could use some exercise, I guess.
say:2:1111003003:0.source_cn: 巧了，正好活动活动筋骨。

say:3:1111006001:0.text: Phew! Karma will get those Quicksand Claws one day!
say:3:1111006001:0.source_cn: 啐！这群该死的流沙之爪，早晚会遭报应！

say:4:1111006002:0.text: That's right, karma's sent us to dish out their punishment.
say:4:1111006002:0.source_cn: 说对了，我们就是流沙之爪的报应。

say:6:1111006004:0.text: ...I left Alkali with a caravan. Our guide lost his bearings when we got caught in a big sandstorm and took the wrong way at a fork...
say:6:1111006004:0.source_cn: ……我跟着商队离开咸水镇，结果路上遇到一场大沙暴。向导...

say:7:1111006005:0.text: The group broke apart, with some leaving and some others missing. I stumbled upon this camp hoping for shelter from the storm, and the next thing I know...
say:7:1111006005:0.source_cn: 商队的人走的走、散的散，我发现这处营地，想借个地方避避...

say:8:1111006006:0.text: You basically walked right into the Quicksand Claws.

say:10:1111006008:0.text: Thank you! And please, if you come across any others from the caravan, help them too...
say:10:1111006008:0.source_cn: 谢、谢谢！要是你们在路上遇到商队的其他人，也请帮帮他们……

say:2:1111007001:1.text: Walker, you sly old fox! Never thought you'd be the one to rescue me.
say:2:1111007001:1.source_cn: 瓦尔克，你这老狐狸！没想到我会有被你救的一天。

say:3:1111007002:1.text: This Mauler kid is your new partner? Looks sharp.
say:3:1111007002:1.source_cn: 这蛮血少年是你的新搭档？不错啊，看起来身手不差。

choice_prompt:4:1111007002.text: This Mauler kid is your new partner? Looks sharp.
choice_prompt:4:1111007002.source_cn: 这蛮血少年是你的新搭档？不错啊，看起来身手不差。

say:5:1111007003:1.text: Yes. Bounty hunters often travel together. You know, if there is an accident, someone can help collect your body... Loners like Walker are extremely rare.
say:5:1111007003:1.source_cn: 当然，赏金猎人常常结伴而行，要是出了意外，能有人收敛遗...
say:5:1111007003:1.male: Yes. Bounty hunters often travel together. You know, if there is an accident, someone can help collect your body... Loners like Walker are extremely rare.
say:5:1111007003:1.female: Yes. Bounty hunters often travel together. You know, if there is an accident, someone can help collect your body... Loners like Walker are extremely rare.

say:7:1111007005:1.text: So, how did they manage to nab you? If word gets out, you'll have a tough time scoring another job.
say:7:1111007005:1.source_cn: 你是怎么被绑的？这事要是传出去，哪个雇主还会找你。

say:8:1111007006:1.text: Hmph! The head of that merchant caravan hired me to escort them out of the Eroded Enclave.
say:8:1111007006:1.source_cn: 哼，就旁边那个旅商，他们商队领头人雇的我。要我保护他们...

say:9:1111007007:1.text: And what brings you here now? Still chasing after Ferranc?
say:9:1111007007:1.source_cn: 你又为什么来这里？难道，你还要找弗兰克……

say:10:1111007008:1.text: Exactly. Need to settle things with him.

say:11:1111007009:1.text: Alone? You're planning to storm the Quicksand Claws' main camp solo? Word is, he's gotten even craftier and those Claws are multiplying.
say:11:1111007009:1.source_cn: 就你一个人？你准备单枪匹马闯进流沙之爪主营？我听说他比...

say:12:1111007010:1.text: I know you're a great shooter, but I hope the tragedy that happened with <style="highlight">Wyatt</style> won't repeat itself.
say:12:1111007010:1.source_cn: 我知道你对枪法很自信，但……别重蹈<style=hig...

choice_prompt:13:1111007010.text: I know you're a great shooter, but I hope the tragedy that happened with <style="highlight">Wyatt</style> won't repeat itself.
choice_prompt:13:1111007010.source_cn: 我知道你对枪法很自信，但……别重蹈<style=highlight>怀亚特</style>的覆辙。

say:14:1111007011:1.text: It's the name of a gun.
say:14:1111007011:1.male: It's the name of a gun.
say:14:1111007011:1.female: It's the name of a gun.

say:15:1111007012:1.text: Jacob, you're getting rusty. Can't believe you got captured by a Claw.
say:15:1111007012:1.source_cn: 杰布，你的枪没以前快了，竟然会被这几个流沙之爪俘获。

say:16:1111007013:1.text: Well, go drown your sorrows and enjoy this second lease on life.
say:16:1111007013:1.source_cn: 去找个酒吧把自己灌醉，好好庆祝劫后余生吧。

say:17:1111007014:1.text: Who knows? Perhaps it's time to retire.
say:17:1111007014:1.source_cn: 谁知道呢，也许我已经不适合再干这行了。

say:18:1111007015:1.text: See ya, Walker. I hope to see you again, just not at a funeral.
say:18:1111007015:1.source_cn: 再见，瓦尔克。希望我们再见时不是在葬礼上。

say:3:1111008001:1.text: Nope, dead end. Definitely not Ferranc's hideout.
say:3:1111008001:1.source_cn: 好吧，这里没什么线索，而且一看就不是弗兰克所在的大本营。

say:4:1111008002:1.text: How did the prophecy go? Crimson rocky land...
say:4:1111008002:1.source_cn: 预言是怎么说来着？红色的岩地……

say:5:1111008003:1.text: Ahem. Let me describe again what I saw in my vision: You must traverse a valley and some crimson-rocky land. The man you're looking for is hidden deep in there.
say:5:1111008003:1.source_cn: 咳嗯，我再描述一下预言中的情景：要穿过一片山谷和赭红色...

say:6:1111008004:1.text: This must be the wrong place, then.

say:7:1111008005:1.text: This is the right way. We've already run into a bunch of Quicksand Claws. My prophecies are never wrong.
say:7:1111008005:1.source_cn: 但遇到了流沙之爪，说明方向没走错。我的预言果然十分准确！

choice_prompt:8:1111008005.text: This is the right way. We've already run into a bunch of Quicksand Claws. My prophecies are never wrong.
choice_prompt:8:1111008005.source_cn: 但遇到了流沙之爪，说明方向没走错。我的预言果然十分准确！

say:9:1111008006:1.text: As I said, it's your fortune to have me!
say:9:1111008006:1.source_cn: 我就说，有我和你们同路，是你们的好运！

say:10:1111008008:1.text: Hmm... We're quite close to the <style="highlight">Sandar Wayrest</style>.

say:11:1111008009:1.text: Let's get some rest. If the gold I forked out earlier landed in the right pocket, there might be some intel waiting for us.
say:11:1111008009:1.source_cn: 先去那里歇歇脚，如果我之前付出的金币落进了正确的口袋，...

say:13:1111008007:1.text: You must have faith in fate, or you will be doomed to misfortune!
say:13:1111008007:1.source_cn: 不能不相信命运哦，不然会遭厄运反噬的！

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 狐狸尾巴都翘到天上去了……

say:0:1111009001:0.text: The Wayrest is up ahead. It won't be long.
say:0:1111009001:0.source_cn: 驿站就在前面，很快就能看到了。

say:1:1111009002:0.text: What information can we get from there?
say:1:1111009002:0.male: What information can we get from there?
say:1:1111009002:0.female: What information can we get from there?

say:2:1111010001:0.text: Long time no see, Walker. You finally found some new partners?
say:2:1111010001:0.source_cn: 稀客啊。瓦尔克，这次带着新搭档来了？

say:3:1111010002:0.text: Come on, do I really need one?
say:3:1111010002:0.source_cn: 唉，一个两个都是这样。我看起来很需要一个新搭档吗？

say:4:1111010003:0.text: Ahh... I miss those old times.
say:4:1111010003:0.source_cn: 只是看到你，就会想起之前的日子。

say:5:1111010004:0.text: If you guys had made it back then, those crazy Quicksand Claws wouldn't be causing so much trouble now!
say:5:1111010004:0.source_cn: 要是你们当时成功了，流沙之爪，那群鸟背上的疯子，也不会...

say:6:1111010005:0.text: Excuse me, I don't usually talk this much. The person you're looking for is outside.
say:6:1111010005:0.source_cn: 算了，多嘴不是我的风格。你之前要找的人我带来了，在卸鞍...

say:10:1111010007:0.text: Soren, please, keep your cool when we meet him. Don't mess this up.
say:10:1111010007:0.source_cn: 顺便，索恩小兄弟，待会见了面别太冲动。太年轻气盛容易把...

say:12:1111010009:0.source_cn: 走吧，去见见能给咱们情报的人。

say:4:1111011002:1.text: Relax, alright? He cost me a pretty penny.
say:4:1111011002:1.source_cn: 都说了别太冲动。他是我花大价钱收买的线人。

say:5:1111011003:1.text: I agreed to meet you because of the promise of gold. I never guaranteed any info.
say:5:1111011003:1.source_cn: 我是拿那些闪闪发亮的金币没办法，才答应和你见一面，没答...

say:6:1111011004:1.text: The longer I stick around, the higher the chance I get caught. What's in it for me?
say:6:1111011004:1.source_cn: 在这里待得越久，我暴露的风险越高。风险全是我一个人背，...

say:7:1111011005:1.source_cn: 再加上这些，足够让你面对风险了吗？

say:8:1111011006:1.text: That's mighty generous of you! Must've taken you a good year to earn all this.
say:8:1111011006:1.source_cn: 噢哟，阔绰！这些都够你一年挣的赏金了吧。

say:9:1111011007:1.text: Cut the crap! Why is he here? I could use him as a punching bag.
say:9:1111011007:1.source_cn: 少跟他废话。你让这家伙来这里做什么？不是让我揍来解气的...

say:10:1111011008:1.text: Easy, now. You wanna help your people or not?
say:10:1111011008:1.source_cn: 冷静，你还想不想知道族人的消息？

say:12:1111011010:1.text: Then we play by my rules. One bag of gold for one question.
say:12:1111011010:1.source_cn: 那就按照我的规矩，一个问题，一袋金币。

say:13:1111011011:1.text: Let me make it clear. I'm not giving away the location of our main camp or Ferranc's plans. He treats his men no better than those prisoners. I'm not ready to die yet.
say:13:1111011011:1.source_cn: 事先声明，要我直接说出大本营所在地或者弗兰克的计划，没...

say:14:1111011012:1.text: If that's your question, go ahead, but don't expect an answer. The gold's still mine. You don't like it, I'm out.
say:14:1111011012:1.source_cn: 你们可以问，我不会回答。钱照付。不同意的话就当我今天没来过。

choice_prompt:15:1111011012.text: If that's your question, go ahead, but don't expect an answer. The gold's still mine. You don't like it, I'm out.
choice_prompt:15:1111011012.source_cn: 你们可以问，我不会回答。钱照付。不同意的话就当我今天没来过。

say:16:1111011013:1.text: Unfortunately, before I met Satrana, I had zero clue where the Quicksand Claws were. I paid to bring him here, so we better get something out of it.
say:16:1111011013:1.source_cn: 没办法……遇见萨忒娜小姑娘之前，没有其他方式可以知道流...

say:17:1111011014:1.text: Here's your bag of gold. First question: How's Ferranc holding up? Don't need to know his exact whereabouts.
say:17:1111011014:1.source_cn: 拿着你的钱。第一个问题，弗兰克的近况？我不需要知道他在哪里。

say:18:1111011015:1.text: After hearing rumors about the treasure, he colluded with some men and learned to formulate complex robbery plans. We've been busy since. The leisure days are long gone.
say:18:1111011015:1.source_cn: 哼，听说宝藏传闻后，他和一些人类勾结上，学会了制定复杂...

say:19:1111011016:1.text: His cruelty and arrogance haven't changed a bit. That's all I can say.
say:19:1111011016:1.source_cn: 他和你知道的一样，依旧残忍又自大。其他的，我不能说。

say:20:1111011017:1.text: My clansmen, some young Maulers, where have you taken them?
say:20:1111011017:1.source_cn: 我的族人，一些年轻的蛮血，被你们抓到哪里去了？

say:25:1111011022:1.text: All our prisoners must go through a "training program" at the main camp first. Ferranc will then select outstanding laborers to work at other sites.
say:25:1111011022:1.source_cn: 绑来的俘虏会先在大本营接受“训练”，等能成为优秀的劳工...

say:26:1111011023:1.text: I can't say for sure who your clanspeople are. But if they got nabbed recently, odds are they're at the main camp.
say:26:1111011023:1.source_cn: 我不知道你说的族人是谁，但如果是最近被抓的，那应该还在...

say:27:1111011024:1.text: If they're lucky, they might still be kicking. If not... well, who knows what fate has in store for them.
say:27:1111011024:1.source_cn: 如果运气好，他们就还活着。要是运气不好……谁也说不准。

say:28:1111011025:1.text: Don't sweat it, buddy. You've got quite the fiery spirit. Luck's gotta be on your side.
say:28:1111011025:1.source_cn: 别担心，小兄弟，你脾气这么坏，运气肯定不错。

say:30:1111011027:1.text: Happy? Go on, then. Ask more questions. More money for me.
say:30:1111011027:1.source_cn: 满意了吗？继续继续，再多给我点赚钱的机会！

say:31:1111011028:1.text: Let's go. We've already wasted too much time on this bastard.
say:31:1111011028:1.source_cn: 走。这种人，和他多说一句话都脏了我的嘴。

say:32:1111011029:1.text: Hey—! Friendly advice, folks. If you're thinking of springing your people, Ferranc'll make sure you'll regret it!
say:32:1111011029:1.source_cn: 喂——喂！我可警告一句，要是去劫人，弗兰克不会放过你们的！

say:33:1111011030:1.text: Perfect. My bullet has been waiting.
say:33:1111011030:1.source_cn: 哈，那正好，我的子弹等他很久了。

say:35:1111011020:0.source_cn: 拿去，为今天这个机会，我做足了准备。

choice:15:1:2.text: Can we really trust this guy?
choice:15:1:2.source_cn: 我们一定要从他嘴里打听情报？
choice:15:1:2.male: Can we really trust this guy?
choice:15:1:2.female: Can we really trust this guy?

choice:15:2:3.text: Well, I'm never short on gold.
choice:15:2:3.source_cn: 幸好，我最不缺的就是钱
choice:15:2:3.male: Well, I'm never short on gold.
choice:15:2:3.female: Well, I'm never short on gold.

say:0:1111012001:0.text: So, what's your beef with Ferranc?
say:0:1111012001:0.source_cn: 你和流沙之爪的弗兰克，有什么过节？

say:1:1111012002:0.text: Hey, you've got the info you need. Don't get distracted now, alright?
say:1:1111012002:0.source_cn: 小兄弟，已经拿到情报了，现在是分心的时候吗？

say:2:1111012003:0.text: The caravan was robbed on this road. There must be traces of the Quicksand Claws. Don't miss anything.
say:2:1111012003:0.source_cn: 商队在这条路上遭劫，这附近应该有流沙之爪出没的线索，别...

say:0:1111013001:0.text: A damaged carriage. It looks horrible...
say:0:1111013001:0.source_cn: 是损毁的马车，看着好惨呐……

say:1:1111013002:0.text: Probably the caravan the merchant was with. Let's take a better look.
say:1:1111013002:0.source_cn: 应该是被咱们所救的那个商人的商队，凑近点看看。

say:0:1111014001:0.text: Brutal stuff... Definitely the handiwork of the Quicksand Claws.
say:0:1111014001:0.source_cn: 这赶尽杀绝的样子，没错，就是流沙之爪那群混蛋干的。

say:2:1111014003:0.text: The cuts on these wooden boards look fresh. They ain't been gone long.
say:2:1111014003:0.source_cn: 车上木板的断裂痕迹很新，他们应该还没走远。

say:0:1111015001:0.text: Another carriage! It's obviously been plundered. No need for divination.
say:0:1111015001:0.source_cn: 前面又有一辆马车，不需要做出任何占卜预言，也能看出它是...

say:2:1111015003:0.text: This one's in better shape. Maybe some merchants made a run for it and left us some clues.
say:2:1111015003:0.source_cn: 看起来损毁程度不太高，不知道逃走的商人有没有留下一些线索。

say:0:1111016001:0.text: The Quicksand Claws are targeting gunpowder and digging tools.
say:0:1111016001:0.source_cn: 对准火药和挖掘工具下手，看来流沙之爪是瞄准深红高原的宝...

say:1:1111016002:0.text: Their goal must be to find the treasure of the Crimson Highlands.
say:1:1111016002:0.source_cn: 人人都想发财，但像他们这么丧心病狂的，也是不多见。

say:2:1111016003:0.text: They must be punished for using powerful gunpowder for looting and plundering!
say:2:1111016003:0.source_cn: 哼，要是把效力那么强的火药用在劫掠上，我赌咒他们一定会...

say:0:1111017001:0.text: There are more Quicksand Claws camps in this area.
say:0:1111017001:0.source_cn: 这附近，流沙之爪的营地变多了。
say:0:1111017001:0.male: There are more Quicksand Claws camps in this area.
say:0:1111017001:0.female: There are more Quicksand Claws camps in this area.

say:1:1111017002:0.text: Then they must be lurking around.
say:1:1111017002:0.source_cn: 说明那群混蛋就盘踞在这附近。

say:2:1111017003:0.text: Don't waste time on those minions. We want the big fish.
say:2:1111017003:0.source_cn: 别和喽啰起冲突，咱们要瞄准的是领头的脑袋。

say:3:1111017004:0.text: Once Ferranc's defeated, the rest of the Quicksand Claws will be like lost puppies.
say:3:1111017004:0.source_cn: 弗兰克一完蛋，剩下的流沙之爪就只是散兵游勇，构不成威胁。

say:1:1111018002:0.text: Take everything useful back to the main camp!
say:1:1111018002:0.source_cn: 还能用的东西全带回主营去！

say:4:1111020002:1.text: You held your own back there.

say:7:1111020005:1.text: Better? My fury's burning hotter than ever.
say:7:1111020005:1.source_cn: 比起解气，更像仇恨的火药被重新点爆了。

say:8:1111020006:1.source_cn: ……刚才那混蛋说的话，你没什么要问的？

say:9:1111020007:1.text: I don't care about your past; I mean it.
say:9:1111020007:1.source_cn: 我说过，你的过去，我不关心。

say:10:1111020008:1.text: What happened between you and Wyatt, how he met his end, and why you're out for vengeance—it's none of my concern.
say:10:1111020008:1.source_cn: 你和怀亚特之间发生了什么，他怎么牺牲，你为什么寻仇，和...

say:11:1111020009:1.text: We can continue to travel together as long as you still want to beat Ferranc.
say:11:1111020009:1.source_cn: 但是，只要你还想彻底击溃弗兰克，我们就可以继续同路。

say:13:1111020011:1.text: Taking down the big boss of the Quicksand Claws would be the cherry on top.
say:13:1111020011:1.source_cn: 也可以再顺手击败一两个流沙之爪的首领。

say:14:1111020012:1.text: Those who have betrayed the honor and faith of the Maulers need a lesson.
say:14:1111020012:1.source_cn: 对于那些背弃了蛮血荣耀和信念的混蛋，得有人给他们一点教训。

say:15:1111020013:1.text: That's right. Some clans in the Ashen Wastes are quite unreasonable, but not as bad as these Quicksand Claws!
say:15:1111020013:1.source_cn: 就是就是，荒角沙漠的氏族虽然有的也不讲理，但也不像流沙...

say:16:1111020014:1.text: Even a good-natured girl like me can't stand it any longer!
say:16:1111020014:1.source_cn: 连我这么好脾气的姑娘，都看不下去了！

choice_prompt:17:1111020014.text: Even a good-natured girl like me can't stand it any longer!
choice_prompt:17:1111020014.source_cn: 连我这么好脾气的姑娘，都看不下去了！

say:18:1111020015:1.text: That Quicksand Claw we just took out? That was Lionheart, Ferranc's right-hand man.
say:18:1111020015:1.source_cn: 刚才被咱们干掉的那个流沙之爪，叫鬣心。算是弗兰克的副手。

say:19:1111020016:1.text: We've gotta be closing in on their main camp.
say:19:1111020016:1.source_cn: 这样看来，流沙之爪的大本营，不远了。

choice:17:0:1.text: It's time to make some noise!
choice:17:0:1.male: It's time to make some noise!
choice:17:0:1.female: It's time to make some noise!

choice:17:1:2.text: Come on! Let's kick some ass!
choice:17:1:2.source_cn: 走吧，去找流沙之爪算账！
choice:17:1:2.male: Come on! Let's kick some ass!
choice:17:1:2.female: Come on! Let's kick some ass!

cinematic_dialogue:2:1111018002:.text: Take everything useful back to the main camp!
cinematic_dialogue:2:1111018002:.source_cn: 还能用的东西全带回主营去！

say:6:1111019001:1.text: Look who we've stumbled upon! The hero of Alkali, the one who dared to take on the chief of the Quicksand Claws—bounty hunter extraordinaire, Walker!
say:6:1111019001:1.source_cn: 看看谁来了？咸水镇的大英雄，曾经刺杀流沙之爪首领的赏金...

say:7:1111019002:1.text: Almost forgot. That assassination attempt didn't go quite as planned, did it? You barely dodged Ferranc's blade, am I right?
say:7:1111019002:1.source_cn: 哦——对不起，我忘了，那次刺杀行动失败了，对吧？你从弗...

say:9:1111019004:1.text: And your partner... What was his name again? White? Tiat?
say:9:1111019004:1.source_cn: 你的搭档。我还记得他。怀特？还是提亚特？

say:10:1111019005:1.text: Quite the odd pair, you two. Walker and Tiat, a human and a Mauler. There wasn't a job you guys couldn't handle for the right price...
say:10:1111019005:1.source_cn: 奇怪的赏金猎人搭档，瓦尔克与提亚特，人类和蛮血，只要价...

choice_prompt:11:1111019005.text: Quite the odd pair, you two. Walker and Tiat, a human and a Mauler. There wasn't a job you guys couldn't handle for the right price...
choice_prompt:11:1111019005.source_cn: 奇怪的赏金猎人搭档，瓦尔克与提亚特，人类和蛮血，只要价格合适，没有完不成的任务……

say:13:1111019007:1.text: That's right, Wyatt! His new name! Remember that day? Bossman Ferranc put a bullet in his head out in the desert. How was the funeral?
say:13:1111019007:1.source_cn: 哦，对，怀亚特！那是他的新名字！我记得弗兰克头儿在沙漠...

say:14:1111019008:1.text: Maulers don't shed tears for the weak. But what about you humans? Did ya cry your eyes out over his coffin?
say:14:1111019008:1.source_cn: 蛮血不会为弱者哭泣，那你们人类呢？会对着棺材哀悼吗？

say:17:1111019011:1.text: So, Walker's recruited you to come after us for revenge?
say:17:1111019011:1.source_cn: 搭档死了，瓦尔克想找我们复仇，就找上你了？

say:18:1111019012:1.text: I'm not anyone's partner! Quit making up stories.
say:18:1111019012:1.source_cn: 我、不是、任何人的搭档！别拿我和他混为一谈！

say:19:1111019013:1.text: Watch your tongue, Mauler punk. Your buddy here is leading you straight to hell.
say:19:1111019013:1.source_cn: 蛮血小子，别不知好歹，你信任的同伴正在把你送上绝路呢。

say:20:1111019014:1.text: He knows damn well how tough we are, yet he's still brought you here to challenge us. Aren't you scared of biting the dust?
say:20:1111019014:1.source_cn: 他知道我们的厉害，所以才带着你来挑战我们，你就不怕陪他...

say:21:1111019015:0.text: I couldn't care less about his history.
say:21:1111019015:0.source_cn: 瓦尔克的过去，我管不着。

say:22:1111019016:1.text: But you on the other hand are really getting on my nerves!
say:22:1111019016:1.source_cn: 我只知道，你，让我很不爽！

choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 瓦尔克之前的搭档，是蛮血？

choice:11:2:3.text: I knew it wasn't just a gun.
choice:11:2:3.source_cn: 我就猜到那不光是一把枪的名字
choice:11:2:3.male: I knew it wasn't just a gun.
choice:11:2:3.female: I knew it wasn't just a gun.

narration:24:11010110:0.text: The raiders of the caravan are indeed a group of Quicksand Claws. They seem to know Walker.
narration:24:11010110:0.source_cn: 劫掠商队的果然是一群流沙之爪。他们似乎认识瓦尔克。
